note: The guinea pig market. Numbers tuned by the human; code only reads them (loader: Cuy.Core.World.MarketConfig). Design: docs/WORLD.md section 5.

invariants.note: sell*(1+wiggle) must stay below buy*(1-wiggle): no loop earns clovers from buying and selling

demand.note: each crop has a demand meter 0.05-1.0; the buyer pays sell_price x wiggle x meter; every unit sold lowers the meter by drop_per_unit, every new day raises it by recover_per_day. About recover/drop units of each crop per day sell near full price; hauling more is nearly worthless. Diversity pays. The total of a whole sale is floored, never a single unit.
